note: Game roles (Figma Screen 2/2b). Bonuses are SIMULATED GAME VALUES.

roles.name: SYSTEMS
roles.desc: Leads the team. Keeps the mission goal in mind and makes the final call when the crew disagrees.
inMission: Checks that every choice serves the science goal
Keeps an eye on budget and schedule
Bonus: Final say in team decisions

roles.name: ENGINEER
roles.desc: Builds the spacecraft. Knows power, mass and budget, and which parts fit together.
inMission: Bonus: Energy ×2 when installing solar panels

roles.name: SCIENCE
roles.desc: Chooses the instruments and the rocks to study. Turns clues into evidence.
inMission: Reads the scan results in Rock Hunter

roles.name: COMMUNICATION
roles.desc: Talks to Earth. Plans the data route, the contact windows and what gets sent first.
inMission: Times the data packets in Signal Run
